subject: general
question: According to the Census of India-2011, which of the following options represents a group of the most urbanised union territories in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Delhi and Chandigarh** are the most urbanized union territories in India according to the Census of India-2011.
 
• The Census of India-2011 provides comprehensive data on the urbanization levels across various states and union territories.
 
• Urbanization is measured by the proportion of the population living in urban areas compared to the total population.
 
• Delhi, being the capital territory, has a significant urban population with extensive infrastructure and metropolitan features.
 
• Chandigarh, designed by the famous architect Le Corbusier, is known for its urban planning and high urban population density.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the Census of India-2011, urbanization in India has been on the rise, with more people moving to cities for better opportunities and living standards.
 
• Union territories like **Delhi and Chandigarh** have seen rapid urban growth due to their strategic importance and administrative functions.
 
• Urban planning and development initiatives in these territories have contributed to their high urbanization levels.
 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years and is the most reliable source of demographic data in the country.
